transcript.content: Hello, it’s nice to meet you. What brings you in today?

Hi, nice to meet you too. Well, I suppose what finally scared me into coming in is that... after I eat too much, I’ve been making myself throw up in the bathroom. I do it so I won’t gain weight. It’s just gotten to the point where it isn’t a one-time mistake anymore, and I know I need to talk to someone about it.
Is your current body weight significantly below what is considered healthy for you?

No, it's not. I'm definitely not underweight. My weight is actually pretty normal for my age and height. I just... well, I do all of this because I'm terrified of gaining, but no, I'm not below a healthy weight right now.
During these episodes, do you feel unable to control your eating or stop once you start?

Yes, I do. Once I start eating during those times, it really just feels like I’m on automatic. I'll be thinking to myself that I should stop, you know, before my husband notices what I'm doing, but... I just keep reaching for one more thing anyway. I just can't seem to stop myself.
How often do these episodes of eating too much and then making yourself vomit occur?

Well, for at least the past several months, it’s been happening most weeks. I'll have one of those secret eating spells, and then... well, I go make myself sick afterward. I really can’t honestly call it occasional anymore.
